house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-ahab@8d.note: Ahab is 'the son of Omri' (16.29) and succeeded his father Omri (16.28).

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-ahaziah.note: Ahaziah is 'the son of Ahab' (22.51); Ahab is Omri's son (16.29).

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-baasha@.note: Baasha founded the house named for him. The excerpt does not name the king he killed (16.7 says only 'because he killed him').

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-elah@41.note: Elah is 'the son of Baasha' (16.8) and succeeded his father (16.6).

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-hoshea@.note: Hoshea conspired against Pekah and slew him (15.30), so by the rule he founded a new house. The text does not name the house.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-jehoash.note: Jehoash is 'the son of Jehoahaz' (13.10), who was the son of Jehu (13.1).

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-jehu@7c.note: Jehu is anointed king to destroy Ahab's house (9.6-7). The excerpt does not show him killing his predecessor, so founding the house is inferred.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-jeroboa.note: Jeroboam is made king over all Israel (12.20). The house named for him is inferred from the rule, not stated in the text.
Jeroboam is 'the son of Joash king of Israel' (14.23); Joash is 'son of Jehoahaz' (14.1), who was the son of Jehu (13.1).

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-joram@8.note: Jehoram is 'the son of Ahab' (3.1); Ahab is Omri's son (16.29).

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-menahem.note: His son Pekahiah reigned after him (15.22), so the house is named for him. The excerpt does not show him killing Shallum.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-omri@8d.note: His son Ahab reigned in his stead (16.28), so the house is named for Omri.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-pekah@3.note: Pekah killed Pekahiah and took the throne (15.25), so by the rule he founded a new house. Hoshea later slew him (15.30). The house is inferred, not stated.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-shallum.note: Shallum conspired against Zachariah, slew him and reigned (15.10), so by the rule he founded a new house. The house is inferred, not stated.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-tibni@b.note: Half the people made Tibni king, but those following Omri prevailed; Tibni died and Omri reigned (16.22). No reign of Tibni is stated.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-zachari.note: Zachariah is 'the son of Jeroboam' (15.8), i.e. Jeroboam II, son of Joash (14.23), in the house of Jehu.

house:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-zimri@2.note: Zimri reigned seven days (16.15) and slew the king (16.16). By the rule he founded no dynasty. The house is inferred, not stated.

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-abijam@9.note: KJV: his heart was not perfect 'as the heart of David his father' (15.3), a Davidic descendant.

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-ahaz@91f.note: Ahaz is 'the son of Jotham' (16.1), and succeeded him as 'his son' (15.38).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-ahaziah-.note: Ahaziah is 'the son of Jehoram king of Judah' (8.25); Jehoram is 'the son of Jehoshaphat' (8.16).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-amaziah@.note: Amaziah is 'the son of Joash king of Judah' (14.1).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-amon@91f.note: Amon 'did ... as his father Manasseh did' (21.20), so he is Manasseh's son.

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-asa@91fc.note: Asa is 'Asa his son' (15.8), son of Abijam; he did 'as did David his father' (15.11).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-athaliah.note: She is 'the daughter of Omri' (8.26), not a son. She destroyed the royal seed and reigned (11.1-3). By the rule she founded no Omri house.

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-hezekiah.note: Hezekiah is 'the son of Ahaz king of Judah' (18.1).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-jeconiah.note: Jehoiachin is Jehoiakim's son and reigned 'in his stead' (24.6); Jehoiakim is Josiah's son (23.34).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-jehoiaki.note: Eliakim, 'the son of Josiah', was renamed Jehoiakim by Pharaoh (23.34).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-jehoram@.note: Jehoram is 'the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah' (8.16).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-jehoshap.note: Jehoshaphat is 'the son of Asa' (22.41); Asa is Abijam's son (15.8).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-joash@91.note: Joash is 'the son of Ahaziah' (11.2); Ahaziah is the son of Jehoram king of Judah (8.25).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-josiah@9.note: Josiah is 'Josiah his son' after Amon (21.26), and walked 'in all the way of David his father' (22.2).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-jotham@9.note: Jotham is 'Jotham his son' after Azariah (15.7), and 'the son of Uzziah' (15.32).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-manasseh.note: He is Hezekiah's son: Hezekiah is 'his father' whose high places Manasseh rebuilt (21.3).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-rehoboam.note: Rehoboam is 'his son' (11.43), succeeding Solomon, who was buried 'in the city of David his father'.

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-uzziah@9.note: Azariah (Uzziah) is 'the son of Amaziah' (15.1); Jotham succeeds Azariah as 'his son' (15.7), 'the son of Uzziah' (15.32).

house:united-kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-.note: David was anointed king over Judah (2sam.2.4); Solomon sat on 'the throne of David his father' (1kgs.2.12).
The excerpt calls Saul 'your master' and names his son Ishbosheth (2sam.2.8), but does not state Saul's reign. Kingship is not shown in the excerpt.
Solomon sat 'upon the throne of David his father' (2.12); he was buried 'in the city of David his father' (11.43).

note:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-tibni@8e.note: Half the people followed Tibni 'to make him king' (16.21); those following Omri prevailed (16.22).

note:kingdom-of-israel/reign-of-zimri@c4.note: 'did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah' (16.15).

note:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-athaliah@.note: 8.26 calls her 'the daughter of Omri', not Ahab. 'The daughter of Ahab' (8.18) is Jehoram's unnamed wife. She did reign over the land (11.3).

note:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-jehoram@6.note: He began to reign 'Jehoshaphat being then king' (8.16). That fits co-regency, but the excerpt does not say so.
